baseline.scan_source: git archive of origin/main at repo_sha, extracted to a clean directory (the engine reports repo_sha 'unknown' and working_tree_dirty true there because the archive has no .git)

matching.exact: rule + owning_skill + normalized evidence. Normalization repairs the double-encoded UTF-8 in remaining-candidates.json, applies NFKC, maps em/en dashes to '-', collapses whitespace and lowercases. Line numbers are excluded because SIDE-004 is always line 0 and ARTF-001 anchors changed in v1.13.1.
matching.drift: no exact match, but the same rule + owning_skill + SIDE-004 mutation class already has a disposition; only the quoted first-match snippet changed
matching.new: no prior disposition for that rule + owning_skill + class. The engine emits at most one SIDE-004 candidate per class per skill, so a new class is a new candidate even when the skill has other dispositioned classes

fingerprint_algorithm: first 12 hex SHA256 of compact UTF-8 JSON [rule,file,reported_line,evidence], ensure_ascii=False (same as 2026-09-12)
line_number_note: SIDE-004 reports line 0 (a workflow-level match); matched_skill_line is the reviewer-located raw SKILL.md line of the first match. ARTF-001 lines are raw-file anchors (v1.13.1).
reviewers: read-only disposition review 2026-09-26 (skill-quality-reviewer check 7 applied to every SIDE-004 and ARTF-001 row)
excluded_by_instruction: EVAL-002 aegis-setup: fixed by PR #359; not emitted on this scan
STATE-001 P0 x2: recorded false positives; not reopened
